basic_info.description: Charming 1924 single-story home in the heart of San Francisco's vibrant Outer Mission neighborhood. This cozy 2-bedroom, 1-bath residence offers 900 square feet of comfortable living space on a 1,900 square foot lot (APN: 7031-007E). Perfect for first-time buyers or those seeking a low-maintenance lifestyle, this detached home features classic architectural details and a functional layout with 5 total rooms. Enjoy the convenience of city living with easy access to local amenities, public transit, and major highways. No HOA fees or garage, but ample street parking available. Don’t miss this opportunity to own a piece of San Francisco history! Please use GPS for directions.
